_context.theme: Row of the workspace menu holding the light/dark/system theme switch.
_context.language: Row of the workspace menu opening the list of languages the app can speak.
_context.signIn: Button for an anonymous visitor to sign in.
_context.power.menuItem: Admin menu item: restart the machine (server) the workspace runs on.
_context.restoring.steps.machine: Step of a workspace restore, done.
_context.workspaceMenu.brain: Name of the workspace knowledge base feature.
_context.controlCenter.title: Command palette of the app (search agents, settings, conversations).
_context.controlCenter.quotedQuery: What the person typed, quoted, beside "Ask your Chief of Staff".
_context.controlCenter.hints.searchPage: Footer hint. <keys></keys> is replaced by the keyboard keys (⌘ F): pressing them again opens the browser's own find in page.
_context.controlCenter.hints.open: Footer hint next to the Enter key: opens the selected row.
_context.controlCenter.hints.more: Footer hint next to the Tab key: opens more options for the selected row.
_context.controlCenter.headings.open: Section heading listing the tabs of a coworker's panel that can be opened.
_context.controlCenter.status.off: Badge of a coworker that is turned off.
_context.controlCenter.pro: Badge: feature of the paid plan.
_context.controlCenter.boxAgents: Detail of a Box row: how many agents it holds.
_context.boxNameSuggestions: Above a row of suggested names for a new Box.
_context.providerStatus.headline.one: Banner when one AI provider has an incident. {providers} is its name.
_context.providerStatus.headline.many: Banner when several AI providers have an incident. {providers} is a list of names already joined ("Anthropic and OpenAI").
_context.providerStatus.headlineLong.one: Same as headline.one, with a second sentence, on wide screens.
_context.providerStatus.headlineLong.many: Same as headline.many, with a second sentence, on wide screens.
_context.workspaceMenu.summary.limits: Under the workspace name. {agents} is a number. {seats} is already translated ("3 seats").
_context.workspaceMenu.summary.limitsUnlimited: Under the workspace name, when the plan has no coworker limit. {seats} is already translated ("3 seats").
_context.site.title: Browser tab title and link preview title of the app's pages that have none of their own. Keep "{brand} | " at the start.
_context.site.description: Meta description of the app's pages, shown under the title in search results and link previews. {trialDays} is a number of days.
_context.controlCenter.description: {named} is yes once the workspace gave its Chief of Staff (the workspace's AI assistant) a name of its own, {name}; otherwise the default wording is used.
_context.controlCenter.askRerun: {named} is yes once the workspace gave its Chief of Staff (the workspace's AI assistant) a name of its own, {name}; otherwise the default wording is used.
_context.controlCenter.headings.assistant: {named} is yes once the workspace gave its Chief of Staff (the workspace's AI assistant) a name of its own, {name}; otherwise the default wording is used.
_context.controlCenter.placeholder.rootAssistant: {named} is yes once the workspace gave its Chief of Staff (the workspace's AI assistant) a name of its own, {name}; otherwise the default wording is used.
_context.controlCenter.commands.ask_assistant: {named} is yes once the workspace gave its Chief of Staff (the workspace's AI assistant) a name of its own, {name}; otherwise the default wording is used.
_context.controlCenter.sources.all: Chip of the global search: every source at once. Followed by a number of results.
_context.controlCenter.sources.coworker: Chip of the global search: results in the coworkers (AI agents), their name or their soul (system prompt).
_context.controlCenter.headings.bestMatches: Heading above the results of the global search mixed from every source.
_context.controlCenter.notice.unavailable: Under the results of the global search, when the workspace's machine did not answer: only names and conversation titles were searched. A soul is a coworker's system prompt.
_context.controlCenter.notice.partial: Under the results of the global search, when it ran out of time before reading everything.
_context.controlCenter.hints.nextSource: Footer hint next to the Tab key: shows the results of the next source (Coworkers, Skills, Files…).
_context.controlCenter.hit.sourceWhere: Beside a search result. {source} is a source name ("Files"), {where} where the result sits ("Shared · marketing/ · line 42").
_context.controlCenter.hit.shared: Owner of a file or a table the whole workspace shares, as opposed to one coworker's.
_context.controlCenter.hit.soul: Where a word was found: the soul (system prompt) of a coworker. {box} is the name of the Box (group) the coworker is in.
_context.controlCenter.hit.skill: Where a word was found: a skill file of a coworker. {owner} is the coworker's name. Keep SKILL.md as is.
_context.controlCenter.hit.brainSkill: Where a word was found: a skill of the Brain (the workspace's shared knowledge base). Keep SKILL.md as is.
_context.controlCenter.hit.file: Where a word was found in a file. {owner} is a coworker's name or the 'shared' text, {folder} a folder path ("marketing/"), {line} a line number.
_context.controlCenter.hit.table: Where a word was found in a database table. {owner} is a coworker's name, {table} the table name, {row} the row number.
_context.controlCenter.hit.conversation: Beside a conversation found by its title. {agent} is the coworker's name, {when} how long ago ("2d ago").
